Vietnam Harvest
Dear David,

First of all, thank you so much for your continued support and for visiting us so often. We truly appreciate it. Serving you is always a pleasure, and we enjoy welcoming you not only as a guest but also as a friend through the stories and conversations we share.

We’ve had many great memories together, and we’re truly sorry about the time there was a delay in our service when we forgot to bring you an ashtray. It was absolutely our responsibility, and we sincerely apologize, as it shouldn’t have happened, especially when the restaurant wasn’t too busy.

We would also like to clarify a possible misunderstanding: our restaurant currently does not apply a service charge. The only additional charge on the bill is VAT, which is required by Vietnamese government regulations.

Our doors are always open, and we hope to see you again soon. Please feel free to drop by anytime, we’ll make sure to provide you with even better experience next time.

Warmest regards,
Vietnam Harvest’s Team

Cozy Rooftop Fusion Vietnamese Restaurant & Bar
Jul 2025 • Friends
Our yearly all gals short ‘shop til we drop’ trips has left us wandering around along the busy streets of Ben Thanh Quan 1 in HCMC.
We chanced upon this cozy restaurant hiding at level 2 with a less than visible sign board (refer to photo attached) 
They offer indoor & outdoor seatings, suitable for both group / a romantic dining.
To our surprise they serve a wide range of really good Vietnamese cuisine with some fusion twist! 
It was sooo good that we ended up with so many dishes just for 4 ladies 
Their cocktails are good too & offers a wide selection of wine.
With their fantastic service we’ve promised them that we’ll return soon & have since recommended this little gem to our family & friends too.

Thank you everyone!
From : Singapore all Ladies new friends

Great food and atmosphere, highly recommend
Jul 2025 • Family
Great food and atmosphere, highly recommend. Dishes were a little bit salty but otherwise tasted very good. Nice view of the street and service is nice. Ordered the fried chicken which had a light crispy skin and was very tender, and the rice was slightly salty but otherwise good. Had the homemade chocolate brownie for desert which was warm, soft and light and came with a small scope of vanilla ice cream and peanuts. Located away from the noisy end of the street and the entrance is a narrow stairway up to a second floor, which is easy to miss.
